root.label: ICE officer shoots Wilber Garces Perez in Texas

events.label: ICE officer shoots Wilber Garces Perez in Texas

slots.name: maximum prison term
slots.sentence: Garces Perez faces up to 20 years in prison if convicted on the assault charge.

slots.name: detention distance
slots.sentence: He had been taken from a hospital where he was being treated after being shot by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in Austin and put in detention at a facility about 140 miles away the same day.

slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: Garces Perez struck an officer with his side mirror on Sept. 20 while trying to drive away, authorities said.

slots.name: body camera status
slots.sentence: The federal officer who shot Garcés Pérez, and who allegedly was hit by the side mirror of the car, was not wearing a body camera.

slots.name: deportation status
slots.sentence: He was also facing deportation when he was stopped while driving on a DoorDash delivery in Austin last month, with some of the incident caught on bystander footage, including how ICE officers called an ambulance and then stood by as the wounded man sat in his car and then was given first aid by local police when they arrived.
